description: This source file implements credential management functionalities, including initialization, clearing secrets, matching credentials, parsing URLs into credential structures, reading/writing credentials from files, and interacting with credential helpers in a Git-like environment.

methods.name: void credential_init(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Initializes a credential structure by setting its fields to default values.

methods.name: void credential_clear(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Clears secrets from a credential structure and resets it.

methods.name: void credential_next_state(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Transitions a credential to its next state by swapping header vectors.

methods.name: void credential_clear_secrets(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Clears secret information like password and credential tokens.

methods.name: void credential_set_capability(struct credential_capability * capa,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Sets a specific capability flag on a credential capability structure based on operation type.

methods.name: void credential_set_all_capabilities(struct credential * c,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Enables all capabilities for a credential.

methods.name: void credential_announce_capabilities(struct credential * c,FILE * fp)
methods.description: Announces the capabilities supported by the credential via a file stream.

methods.name: int credential_match(const struct credential * want,const struct credential * have,int match_password)
methods.description: Checks if two credential structures match based on specified fields.

methods.name: void credential_describe(struct credential * c,struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of a credential, used in prompts.

methods.name: void credential_format(struct credential * c,struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Formats credential data into a URL-like string.

methods.name: char * credential_ask_one(const char * what,struct credential * c,int flags)
methods.description: Prompts the user for a single credential input, such as username or password.

methods.name: int credential_getpass(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Obtains password credentials interactively if configured to do so.

methods.name: int credential_has_capability(const struct credential_capability * capa,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Checks if a credential or capability structure supports a particular operation.

methods.name: int credential_read(struct credential * c,FILE * fp,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Reads credential data from an input stream, parsing key-value pairs.

methods.name: void credential_write(const struct credential * c,FILE * fp,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: writes credential data to an output stream in key-value format.

methods.name: void credential_fill(struct repository * r,struct credential * c,int all_capabilities)
methods.description: Fills in missing credential details by invoking helper programs or prompts.

methods.name: void credential_approve(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Marks credentials as approved and stores them via helpers.

methods.name: void credential_reject(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Rejects and clears credentials, informing helpers to erase stored data.
